analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 14, 2026, reporting a 35% year-on-year growth in quarterly revenue from operations at ₹532 crore and a 36% increase in EBITDA at ₹89 crore. Management highlighted that despite raw material price inflation, geopolitical tensions in West Asia, and early season monsoon concerns, the company delivered resilient performance supported by backward integration, disciplined working capital management, and new complex fertilizer variant introductions. The company expects capacity utilization and production levels to improve in subsequent quarters as raw material availability stabilizes. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong growth in revenue and profit after tax driven by operational efficiency, integrated value chains, and recently expanded capacities at Meghnagar. Management expressed optimism regarding sector tailwinds including favorable monsoons, higher MSP, and government support through the Nutrient-Based Subsidy framework.

guidance.claim: The management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line revenue growth of around 35% to 40% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that improved monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and NBS framework support are expected to sustain fertilizer demand during the rest of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry sales remained strong despite lower production levels due to supply-side constraints rather than weak underlying fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: This indicates that the decline in production was primarily due to supply-side constraints, including raw material availability and logistic challenges, rather than any weakness in underlying fertilizer demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and government backing via the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework create a favorable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is further strengthening long-term sector prospects.
demand_outlook.quote: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is further strengthening long-term sector prospects.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry with comfortable domestic stock levels and favorable monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure given essential food consumption.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has added another 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, taking total capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA are progressively contributing to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA alongside 120,000 MTPA of SSP capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Trading EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% while manufacturing EBITDA margin is around 16%.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices increased from ₹65,000 to ₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% year-on-year reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA reached Rs.90 crore in Q4 FY26, registering a 59% YoY growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: Global market input prices witnessed firming trends from mid-February onwards driven by supply-side constraints.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: • 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: For the quarter, NPK-DAP volume was 53,500 MT, SSP volume was 36,300 MT, and trading volume was 21,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 397,263 MT for the full year FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production for the quarter was 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split to subdivide the face value of equity shares from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia surrounding the Strait of Hormuz introduced uncertainty and higher procurement costs during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global movements and reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates had a direct impact on the cost structure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorables.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia capacity from the SECI agreement will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains focused on disciplined execution and long-term value creation through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

management_commitments.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA.
management_commitments.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects benefits of the capacity expansion to reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
